roadmap.title: Complete the campaign on Hard
roadmap.description: Play every story level on Hard while collecting each level's experience vials and secret chests. Story, collection, and most challenge achievements unlock along the way.

roadmap.title: Clean up challenges and collections
roadmap.description: Use Choose Level to replay specific levels for the remaining combat and traversal challenges, the late-game Wizard tower, the no-death run, and any level whose experience counter is still incomplete.

roadmap.title: Finish the achievement list
roadmap.description: Earn the last remaining achievement. Way Out of the Trine unlocks once every other achievement is complete.

achievements.description: Complete Astral Academy
achievements.summary: Complete the Astral Academy tutorial level.

steps.text: Play through @loc{Astral Academy} and reach the exit at the castle.

achievements.description: Collect all experience in Astral Academy
achievements.summary: Collect all 15 experience vials in Astral Academy.

guide.context: This tutorial level has no enemies, so every @item{experience vial} sits on the main route or a nearby ledge. The @loc{Choose Level} screen tracks level experience separately from enemy kills, and only these green vials count.

steps.text: Take the vial on the opening right-hand ledge, the vial two ledges later by walking onto a rock and jumping up, and the vial in front of the castle entrance by swinging from the ledge in front and jumping.
Shoot the vial off the wooden beam with an arrow, then shoot the rope holding the @item{giant hammer} so it frees a vial and smashes a door into the central treasure room.

In the first castle room, jump from the floor crate to the ledge vial. In the second room, conjure a cube beside the first ledge and jump up-left, and leap up to smash the planks that hold another vial.
Use the Wizard to weigh down the left pan of the @mechanic{scales}, then jump across to the left ledge vial, and flip the board the nearby vial rests on so it rolls to the ground.
At ground level go right, block the fireballs, and jump straight up from the fireball keg to cut the rope for the last vial.
Walk up the plank and jump to cut the rope so the hammer releases and knocks a vial loose, then bash the board at the end of the wooden planks for one more.

achievements.description: Collect all experience in Academy Hallways
achievements.summary: Collect all 25 experience vials in Academy Hallways.

guide.context: The @loc{Choose Level} screen tracks this level's experience separately from enemy kills, so only the green vials count. Both secret chests sit next to an experience vial.

steps.text: Take the vial on the first ledge from the start, then drop to the ground, bash the boards with the Knight for the next vial, and grab the vial on the box atop the branch.
Jump the branches to the candle-lit ledge vial, find the vial in the alcove beyond the spinning platform over the spikes, and take the vial on the floor after the rock-fist door.

Reach the walkway vials by swinging under the bridge and landing on top; the Wizard can set the walkway moving first for momentum. Then grab the vial on the branches above the archer skeleton by the spikes.

Look for the vial hidden in a tree above a checkpoint, up-left of a teeter-totter, and the vial near the grate pressure plate; the Knight jumps up to smash the crate free. The next vial is just below the opened grate.
At the weighted plank, break the boards with the Knight so the Thief can grapple up for two vials. Ride the large wheel into the small alcove for a vial and the first secret chest.
Above the checkpoint, work up and across the skeleton ledges for a vial, then find the vial behind crates over the teeter-totters and another on the rock ledge above it.

Set the four-ledge wheel turning with the Wizard for two vials, take the vial above the waterfall-room exit, and in the next room shoot the rope so the rock fist collapses the bridge, then drop down-left for the last vial and the second secret chest.

achievements.description: Collect all experience in Wolvercote Catacombs
achievements.summary: Collect all 20 experience vials in Wolvercote Catacombs.

guide.context: Only the level's @item{experience vials} count here. The @loc{Choose Level} screen tracks them separately from enemy kills, and the level can be replayed if a vial is missed.

steps.text: Walk right down the opening steps for the first vial, grapple up to the platform above it for two more, and build boxes to reach the vial right of the two fireball throwers.
After the floor grate, flip the plank on the right to drop a vial, then grapple to the vial directly above the next checkpoint.
Jump up-right then up-left from that vial to reach another and the first secret chest. Defeat the skeleton boss by striking its head when it crouches.
In the room that grants the Knight the Strength of the Titans, bring the crates down with the Wizard for a vial, take the vial below the right ledge, and stack boxes to reach the high vial.
Lower the far linked platform to jump across for a vial, cut the rope-held box down for another, and take the vial on the following platform.
Draw boxes over the spikes for a vial, then collect the vial in the skeleton room and the top-left vial above it by grapple, and the vial past the next checkpoint.

Wedge a box into the spikes, then jump up to the vial left of the checkpoint and the second secret chest, take the vial by the spider webs, and raise the third platform so the Knight can break the boards holding the last vial.

achievements.description: Collect all experience in Dragon Graveyard
achievements.summary: Collect all 25 experience vials in Dragon Graveyard.

guide.context: The @loc{Choose Level} screen tracks this level's experience separately from enemy kills, so only the green vials count, and a missed vial can be recovered by replaying.

steps.text: Find the vial under the left tree after the tunnel, knock the vial off the box on the beam, and take the vials past the moving platform behind the archer skeleton.
Drop below the first checkpoint and drop a Wizard box on the boards for a vial; then climb the platforms left of the roller tracks for two vials and the first secret chest.
Collect the vials on and above the roller and swinging platforms, then use the Wizard's new plank to open the shelter holding two vials.
Climb above the spiky ball and the small spinning planks for several vials, then reach the high beams with the Thief for a vial and the second secret chest.
Shoot the vial free from under the platform, take the vial on the swinging ledge, and gather the vials under the swinging spiky ball and between the boxes past the balance platforms.
Climb the balance platforms and jump right to the last platforms for the final vials.

achievements.description: Collect all experience in Crystal Caverns
achievements.summary: Collect all 30 experience vials in Crystal Caverns.

guide.context: The Enchanted Edition holds 30 level vials here, tracked separately from enemy kills on the @loc{Choose Level} screen. The level can be replayed, so none are lost.

steps.text: Take the vial on the plank near the start, the vial on the beam by the first checkpoint, and the vials on the rock ledge right of it.
Break the wall with the rock fist for a vial, then drop just before the bridge for another and dive right into the water cave for two more.
Check behind the box at the lake edge, then build a box and plank to the top-left rock ledge for two vials.
When the bridge breaks, grapple up for two vials and the first secret chest, dive left into the underwater cavern for two more, and follow the water to the very bottom for another.
Use boxes on the spikes to climb the cave walls for a vial, jump to the left rock ledge, follow the boulder down, and cross the spiked beams for the next vial.
Cross the small lake with a box and plank for a vial and the second secret chest, then dive left for another.

Collect the vials around the platforms rising from the water; carry the rock fist from the nearby platform to the water and drop it to smash the submerged boards, then dive into the hidden cavern for three vials.
Take the vial on the second large platform, swing across to the next rock ledge, and finish with the far-right vial in the poisoned swamp forest.

achievements.description: Collect all experience in Crypt of the Damned
achievements.summary: Collect every experience vial in Crypt of the Damned.

guide.context: The @loc{Choose Level} screen tracks this level's experience separately from enemy kills, and only the green vials count. Both secret chests sit beside an experience vial.

steps.text: Take the vial on the beam in the first crypt room, flip the wooden beam for the vial on the floor, and check behind the crates by the first checkpoint.
Break the cliff board with the new fire arrows for a vial, clear the glowing rocks for the vial left of the next checkpoint, and take the two vials on the ledges below the platform after the drop.
Shoot down the roof-board vial in the coffin room, then drop into the darkness instead of crossing the bridge for the next vial, and continue right for another.
Build a box and plank to the rock ledge for a vial and the first secret chest, break the board with a fire arrow before the checkpoint for another, and drop just before the checkpoint for the next.

Climb the platforms for two vials and swing under the bridge before the checkpoint for another; then repair the next broken bridge with the Wizard and swing under it for two vials and the second secret chest.
Defeat the boss by striking its glowing back, then build a weighted plank above the drawbridge to drop down for the last two vials before pulling the lever.

achievements.description: Collect all experience in Forsaken Dungeons
achievements.summary: Collect all 30 experience vials in Forsaken Dungeons.

guide.context: Only the level's @item{experience vials} count; the @loc{Choose Level} screen shows them separately from enemy kills, and the level can be replayed.

steps.text: Break the boards at the top of the stairs with a fire arrow for a vial, hook the spinning wheel for another, and take two more on the ledges to the right.
Past the first checkpoint, grab the vial left of the acid pool, cross the beams or plank over for the next, and take the vial in the fireball and spiky-ball room.
After the water, pull the lever for a vial on the left ledge, then climb the platforms for a vial halfway up and another at the top by the checkpoint.
Find the alcove vial above the hallway by moving the stone right and climbing through the hole, drop down-left for another, and ride the spinning wheel for three more vials.
Take the vial past the drop with spikes above, climb the fireball platforms for another, and pull the lever then use timed jumps or boxes for the vial at the top.
Smash the wall right of the lever with the rock fist for a vial, walk right for two vials and the first secret chest, and head left past the swinging spiked balls for two more.
In the water, use planks or boxes to reach the lever platform for two vials, jump the flipping platforms for another, and defeat the skeleton boss by hitting its head.

Break the boards above the boss for a vial, then run right on ground level after the fight and jump up into the hidden fireball chamber for two vials, the second secret chest, and the last vial on the stairs near the end.

achievements.description: Collect all experience in Throne of the Lost
achievements.summary: Collect all 25 experience vials in Throne of the Lost King.

guide.context: The @loc{Choose Level} screen tracks this level's experience separately from enemy kills; only the green vials count, and a replay can recover any miss.

steps.text: Take the vial under a platform across the spinning boards while watching for falling spiky balls, then move the giant stone for two vials and the first secret chest under the next platform.
Knock the vial off the board by the stacked boxes, jump top-left for another, take the vial on the beam above the giant spiked ball, and continue right for the vial behind the far-right giant stone.
Push the beams over for three vials above the checkpoint, then drop left for a vial and place a box on the hidden button to open the top-right gate.

Swing across the axis ledges for two vials and the chest with the Fast Quiver, take the vial high above the next checkpoint, and cross the floating platforms for more vials on both sides of the closed gate.
Grab the far-right vial before the elevator drop, run left during the drop for two more, and take the vial on the box after the first two cogs.
Plank the small cogs to slow them and take two vials and the second secret chest on the rock platform above, then grab the vial right before the end.

achievements.description: Collect all experience in Fangle Forest
achievements.summary: Collect all 30 experience vials in Fangle Forest.

guide.context: Only the level's @item{experience vials} count; the @loc{Choose Level} screen tracks them separately from enemy kills, and the level can be replayed.

steps.text: Grapple up to the vial hidden behind the leaves left of the start, take the vial on the beam above the spike pit, and collect the vials above and across the spikes.
Take two vials left of the first checkpoint and the vial left of the first secret chest, then dive to the lake bottom for two vials and check underwater to the right for another.
Cross and climb the spike pits and branches for several vials, take two on the rock ledge before the next cavern, and collect the vials on both sides of the first bridge.
Above the first spiked pit after returning to the forest, take two vials, then a branch vial after the long bridge.
Dive for the lake-bottom vials, swim as far right as possible for two more, and swim up through the hole in the boards for two final vials and the second secret chest.
Take the vial in the spider-web area, cross the large gap after it, and finish on the flappy platforms before the last checkpoint.

achievements.description: Collect all experience in Shadowthorn Thicket
achievements.summary: Collect all 20 experience vials in Shadowthorn Thicket.

guide.context: The level-select screen tracks this level's experience separately from enemy kills, so only the @item{experience vials} count, and the level can be replayed.

steps.text: Find the vial under the boards right of the start, take the vial on the fire-skeleton platform, and the vial atop the next swinging platform.
Head into the branches above for two vials and the first secret chest, then take the vial behind the two stones by the first acid pool and the board vial in the middle of the pool.
Climb the trees above the acid pool for two vials, then shoot down the vial on the ledge above the Storm Hammer chest.
Drop through the gap for a vial, take the branch vial after it, and collect the vials along the broken bridge.
Shoot the ropes to drop the rock fist through the wall and take the vial on the next archway, then find the walkway vial and the top-left spider-area vials.
Take the dark-forest vial and the second secret chest past the checkpoint, then finish with the vial between the two spiky balls up the stairs.

achievements.description: Collect all experience in Ruins of the Perished
achievements.summary: Collect all 35 experience vials in Ruins of the Perished.

guide.context: Only the level's @item{experience vials} count; the @loc{Choose Level} screen shows them separately from enemy kills, and a missed vial can be recovered by replaying.

steps.text: Plank up behind the start for the first vial, take the beam vial above the moving platform, and the vial behind the stone at its far end.
Drop from the broken bridge for two vials on either side, then dive straight down and search the bottom-right of the lake for two more.
Swim past the spikes and use a platform to reach the left rock wall, break the right wall boards with the Storm Hammer, and swim up for three vials and the first secret chest.

Take the beam vial up-right of the fallen vial, the ledge vial right of the spinning platform, the boulder vial held by a breakable board, and the vials on the beam by the swinging log and flappy platforms.

Clear the top-left ledge vial after the skeletons, move the rocks for two vials, set up the flappy platforms for two more, and collect the two on the next rock ledge plus the vial in the lake beneath the wooden platform.

Defeat the boss by hitting its back, take the ledge vial after it, the board vial in the poisoned pool, and the vials along the broken bridges and pool end, then the rock-ledge vial entering the ruins.
Swing the giant log high and jump up-right for the last two vials and the second secret chest.

achievements.description: Collect all experience in Heartland Mines
achievements.summary: Collect all 25 experience vials in Heartland Mines.

guide.context: The @loc{Choose Level} screen tracks this level's experience separately from enemy kills; only the green vials count, and the level can be replayed.

steps.text: Go left for the vial on the wooden structure, plank a cog to reach the ledge vial, grapple to the vial by the dropping platform elevator, and take the vial beside it.

Enter the small wooden area below for a vial, check bottom-left behind the large plank, break the boards left of a button and grapple down for another, and collect the vials in the skeleton climb and by the swinging spiked ball.
Search the mine cart, the platform below where it is destroyed, and the rock ledge below that, then work through the small-cogs area for the vial on the cliff above the floating-platform lesson.

Ride the platform right and use a floating platform for two vials, take the one on the rock above them, and collect the platform-area vials including the one behind a board and the top-left rock outcropping vial.
Ride the swinging platform down to the lower-right corner for the last two vials and the second secret chest.

achievements.description: Collect all experience in Bramblestoke Village
achievements.summary: Collect all 30 experience vials in Bramblestoke Village.

guide.context: Only the level's @item{experience vials} count; the @loc{Choose Level} screen tracks them separately from enemy kills, and the level can be replayed.

steps.text: Jump off the bridge for a beam vial, swing above the tree house for two vials and the first secret chest, take the plank vial above the scales, and the vials around the giant spinning wheel.

Take the vial beside the acid pit beneath the wheel, shoot out the vial under the platform right of the first checkpoint, and grab the vial beside it and the ledge vial by the tree house before dropping underground.
After the drop, swing left for three vials and the second secret chest, then defeat the goblin boss by jumping over it and striking its back.
Break the board above the next platform with fire arrows for two vials, check behind the stones, and pull the platform over with the Wizard after the fireballs for two more.
Take the vial left as you leave the underground cavern, weigh the platform to open the gate for two vials, and grab the ledge vial above the gate.

Collect the vials after the Ferris wheel, before the next one, on its platforms, and on the next wheel, then the pond vial, the chamber ledge vial, the right-side vial, and the top-right rock ledge vial.

achievements.description: Collect all experience in Iron Forge
achievements.summary: Collect all 35 experience vials in Iron Forge.

guide.context: The level-select screen tracks this level's experience separately from enemy kills, so only the green vials count. This is the longest level, and a replay can recover any miss.

steps.text: Head upward beyond the swinging spiked ball and break the boards above the scales for a vial and access to the far lever, cross the lava after the scales move for the next vial, and clear the top-left vial in the skeleton room past the gate.
Take the elevator and floating platform to a vial, break the boards under the platform below the checkpoint for another, and collect the vials by the swinging board and past the spiked plank.
Cut down the rope-held platform to stop the fireballs and free a vial, then jump through the far-right roof gap for two vials and the first secret chest.
Cross and drop off the balance platform for two vials, climb the water-section flappy platforms for another, and go up-left past the rock-fist scales.
Swing up for two vials, press the three buttons and descend the slowly opening grate for two vials and the second secret chest, then take the vials that drop from the last button past the right gate.
Jump the flappy platforms for two vials, cross the lava pit, and shoot down the chained-box vial after it.

Take the beam vial over the balance platforms, drop straight down and hug the left wall in the elevator section, grapple up-right for a beam vial, and take the right-wall and bottom-right vials past the next checkpoint.
Collect the beam vial above the spiked ball on the top flappy row, drop into the enclosed area below the last flappy platform for two vials, and swing far left for the last one.

achievements.description: Collect all experience in Tower of Sarek
achievements.summary: Collect all 10 experience vials in Tower of Sarek.

guide.context: Lava rises as you climb, so keep moving and collect as you go. The @loc{Choose Level} screen tracks this level's experience separately from enemy kills, and only the green vials count.

steps.text: Climb and swing to the central beam for the first vial, then take the next vial higher and to the right.
Look on the left as you climb for a vial, use a plank or floating platform for the vial between the pipes, and cross the balancing platform for another.
Take the vial over the statues on the right, shoot the central vial loose with an arrow, and collect the vial left of the flappy platforms.
Grab the vial further up on the right and the last vial near the top on the right.

achievements.description: Collect all experience in the game
achievements.summary: Collect every experience vial in all 15 levels of the game.

guide.context: Only level experience counts, not enemy kills; the @loc{Choose Level} screen shows each level's progress. Every level is replayable, so missing vials can be recovered at the end.

steps.text: Complete the level-experience collections for Astral Academy, Academy Hallways, Wolvercote Catacombs, Dragon Graveyard, and Crystal Caverns.
Complete the level-experience collections for Crypt of the Damned, Forsaken Dungeons, Throne of the Lost King, Fangle Forest, and Shadowthorn Thicket.
Complete the level-experience collections for Ruins of the Perished, Heartland Mines, Bramblestoke Village, Iron Forge, and Tower of Sarek.
Check the @loc{Choose Level} screen for any level whose experience counter is still short and replay that level for the missing vials.

achievements.description: Complete the entire game
achievements.summary: Complete the entire game by finishing all 15 levels through Tower of Sarek.

steps.text: Finish all 15 levels, defeating each boss and hazard, and reach the Trine at the top of @loc{Tower of Sarek}.

achievements.description: Complete the entire game on hardest difficulty (Hardcore mode not required)
achievements.summary: Complete the entire game on Hard difficulty; Hardcore mode is not required.

guide.context: Hard is the hardest setting in the Enchanted Edition; the original game's Very Hard difficulty is not present. Hardcore mode is optional, and Hard can be chosen from the start of a new game.

steps.text: Start a new game and select @mechanic{Hard} difficulty.
Complete all 15 levels, including @loc{Tower of Sarek}, while keeping the difficulty on Hard.

achievements.description: Find all secret items in every level
achievements.summary: Find all 26 secret items hidden in the levels between Academy Hallways and Iron Forge.

guide.context: Each level from Academy Hallways to Iron Forge hides two wooden chests holding these items; Astral Academy and Tower of Sarek have none. Each item goes to the party's shared inventory permanently.

collectibles.name: Necklace of Life
collectibles.location: @loc{Academy Hallways}, between the two giant wheels, approached from the right
collectibles.method: Ride the large wheel into the small alcove and open the wooden chest.

collectibles.name: Ring of Spellcaster
collectibles.location: @loc{Academy Hallways}, with the last vial after the collapsed bridge
collectibles.method: Shoot the rope to drop the rock fist and collapse the bridge, then drop down-left and open the chest.

collectibles.name: Amulet of Mana Gain
collectibles.location: @loc{Wolvercote Catacombs}, on the ledge with a vial above the checkpoint
collectibles.method: Jump up-right then up-left from the vial above the checkpoint and open the chest.
collectibles.note: Restores mana when a different hero kills a monster.

collectibles.name: Mana Vial
collectibles.location: @loc{Wolvercote Catacombs}, just below the vial left of a checkpoint
collectibles.method: Wedge a box into the spikes and jump up to the ledge chest.
collectibles.note: Restores 30% mana when mana is empty; refills at checkpoints.

collectibles.name: Leggings
collectibles.location: @loc{Dragon Graveyard}, by two vials left of the roller tracks
collectibles.method: Climb the platforms left of the roller tracks and open the chest.

collectibles.name: Bottle of Poison
collectibles.location: @loc{Dragon Graveyard}, with a vial on the high wooden beams
collectibles.method: Climb the top wooden beams with the Thief and jump right to the chest platform.
collectibles.note: Adds damage to the Knight's sword or the Thief's arrows.

collectibles.name: Amulet of Sacrifice
collectibles.location: @loc{Crystal Caverns}, by two vials where the skeleton breaks the bridge
collectibles.method: Grapple up to the vials after the bridge breaks and open the chest.
collectibles.note: Converts health into mana when mana runs out.

collectibles.name: Enchanted Mana Crystal
collectibles.location: @loc{Crystal Caverns}, on the rock ledge across the small lake
collectibles.method: Cross the small lake with a box and plank and open the chest.

collectibles.name: Pendant of Life Stealing
collectibles.location: @loc{Crypt of the Damned}, in the dark area by a right-hand rock ledge
collectibles.method: Build a box and plank to the rock ledge and open the chest.
collectibles.note: Restores health when a different hero kills a monster.

collectibles.name: Bracers
collectibles.location: @loc{Crypt of the Damned}, under the bridge holding two vials
collectibles.method: Repair the broken bridge with the Wizard, swing under it with the Thief, and open the chest.

collectibles.name: Enchanted Health Crystal
collectibles.location: @loc{Forsaken Dungeons}, in the room with three vials
collectibles.method: Smash the wall with the rock fist and open the chest.

collectibles.name: Boots
collectibles.location: @loc{Forsaken Dungeons}, in the hidden fireball chamber after the skeleton boss
collectibles.method: After the boss, run right along the ground to the far wall and jump up into the hidden chamber, then open the chest.
collectibles.note: Reduces damage from spikes and ground hazards.

collectibles.name: Statue of Eagle
collectibles.location: @loc{Throne of the Lost King}, with two vials under a platform
collectibles.method: Move the giant stone under the platform and open the chest.
collectibles.note: Reduces the mana cost of summoned objects.

collectibles.name: Blue Masterstone
collectibles.location: @loc{Throne of the Lost King}, on a rock platform above the small cogs
collectibles.method: Plank the small cogs to slow them, climb to the rock platform, and open the chest.
collectibles.note: Adds one Wizard box or one Thief arrow.

collectibles.name: Scales of Fish
collectibles.location: @loc{Fangle Forest}, on the island in the lake after the underground cavern
collectibles.method: Dive through the underground cavern and open the chest on the island.
collectibles.note: Lets the wearer breathe underwater without limit.

collectibles.name: Necklace of Power
collectibles.location: @loc{Fangle Forest}, in the water area with the last vials
collectibles.method: Swim right and up through the hole in the boards and open the chest.

collectibles.name: Prism of Light
collectibles.location: @loc{Shadowthorn Thicket}, in the branches with two vials
collectibles.method: Climb into the branches above the third swinging platform and open the chest.

collectibles.name: Health Vial
collectibles.location: @loc{Shadowthorn Thicket}, in the dark trees past a checkpoint
collectibles.method: Find the dark tree area past the checkpoint and open the chest.
collectibles.note: Restores 25% health when health drops below 25%; refills at checkpoints.

collectibles.name: Amulet of Fortitude
collectibles.location: @loc{Ruins of the Perished}, with three vials after the spiked rock face
collectibles.method: Swim up the left rock wall and open the chest at the top.

collectibles.name: Red Masterstone
collectibles.location: @loc{Ruins of the Perished}, with the last two vials
collectibles.method: Swing the giant log high and jump up-right to the beam, then open the chest.
collectibles.note: Adds one Wizard plank or 10% Knight health.

collectibles.name: Orb of Mana
collectibles.location: @loc{Heartland Mines}, on the ledge above the point where the mine cart leaves the tracks
collectibles.method: Follow the mine cart route and climb to the ledge above the cart's fall.

collectibles.name: Pendant of the Guardian
collectibles.location: @loc{Heartland Mines}, at the bottom-right with the last vials
collectibles.method: Ride the swinging platform down to the bottom-right and open the chest.

collectibles.name: Wolfgang's Music Box
collectibles.location: @loc{Bramblestoke Village}, with two vials above the tree house
collectibles.method: Grapple over to the board that sits above the tree house and open the chest.

collectibles.name: Gem of Resurrection
collectibles.location: @loc{Bramblestoke Village}, reached by swinging left after dropping underground
collectibles.method: Grapple the wheel to swing left after the drop and open the chest.
collectibles.note: Revives one hero once per level.

collectibles.name: Amulet of the Kings
collectibles.location: @loc{Iron Forge}, with two vials reached through the far-right roof gap after the gate
collectibles.method: Jump through the roof gap for the two vials and open the chest.

collectibles.name: Victor's Crown
collectibles.location: @loc{Iron Forge}, with two vials in the water section
collectibles.method: Press the three buttons and descend the slowly opening grate, then open the chest halfway down.

achievements.description: Build a tower with at least 12 Wizard-created objects and stand on top of the tower without collapsing it
achievements.summary: Build a tower of at least 12 Wizard-conjured objects and stand on top of it without it collapsing.

guide.context: The Wizard carries more conjured objects as he upgrades. Three points in the box ability gives four boxes, three points in the plank ability gives four planks, and the Blue Masterstone, Red Masterstone, Wolfgang's Music Box, and Victor's Crown each add more.

steps.text: Max the Wizard's box and plank abilities and collect the @item{Blue Masterstone}, @item{Red Masterstone}, @item{Wolfgang's Music Box}, and @item{Victor's Crown} so he can conjure seven boxes and seven planks.
In an open area with flat ground, conjure a stable stack of at least 12 objects, alternating planks and boxes.
Climb the stack and stand on top of it without letting it topple.

achievements.description: Kill 5 monsters (or 3 in Enchanted Edition) with a single physical object drop or throw
achievements.summary: Kill three monsters in the Enchanted Edition with a single dropped or thrown object.

guide.context: In the Enchanted Edition the target is three kills in one impact, not five.

steps.text: In @loc{Academy Hallways}, gather three early skeletons close together.
As the Wizard, conjure a large @item{plank} in the air above the group.
Drop or throw the plank so the single impact kills all three skeletons.

achievements.description: Complete Tower of Sarek without any deaths on hardest difficulty (Hardcore mode not required)
achievements.summary: Complete Tower of Sarek on Hard difficulty without any character deaths.

guide.context: Hard is the hardest setting in the Enchanted Edition, and Hardcore mode is not required. Any character death during the climb fails the run, so restart the level if one dies.

steps.text: Replay @loc{Tower of Sarek} on @mechanic{Hard} difficulty.
Climb with the Thief's grapple and the Wizard's planks, shooting down the boxes and planks Sarek throws before they block the route.
Reach the Trine at the top without any character dying.

achievements.description: In a single level, kill one monster by jumping on it with the Knight, one with the Wizard's abilities and one with the Thief's grappling hook kick
achievements.summary: Within one level, defeat a monster by jumping on it as the Knight, one using a Wizard ability, and one by kicking an enemy with the Thief's grappling hook.

guide.context: All three kills must happen in the same level, and each kill must be finished by the named method.

steps.text: In @loc{Academy Hallways}, reach the early skeletons and keep three of them near a ledge.
Kill one skeleton with the @npc{Thief}'s grappling-hook kick by swinging into it until it dies.
Kill one with a @npc{Wizard} ability by dropping a conjured cube onto its head.
Kill one with the @npc{Knight} by jumping down onto it from a height.

achievements.description: Survive a level other than Astral Academy without any damage
achievements.summary: Finish any level except Astral Academy without taking any damage.

guide.context: Any hit from an enemy or hazard breaks the run, so pick a level with no forced damage and keep your distance.

steps.text: Replay @loc{Academy Hallways}, choosing Easy difficulty if you want fewer threats.
Use the @npc{Thief}'s bow to kill enemies from range and avoid spikes, fire, and falls.
Reach the end of the level without taking a single hit.

achievements.description: Complete a level with 25 or more character deaths
achievements.summary: Finish a level after recording 25 or more character deaths.

guide.context: The death count is per level, and the level must still be completed for the achievement to register.

steps.text: Pick any level with a fast death, such as one with lava or acid near the start.
Lose characters to enemies or hazards until 25 or more have died.
Complete the level after reaching 25 deaths.

achievements.description: Conjure 200 objects in a single level
achievements.summary: Conjure 200 objects during a single level.

guide.context: The total is per level, so all 200 conjurations must happen in one visit.

steps.text: Play any level as the @npc{Wizard} and stand near a checkpoint.
Repeatedly conjure and dispel @item{planks} or boxes until 200 objects have been created.

achievements.description: Complete a level other than Astral Academy without directly killing any enemies
achievements.summary: Finish any level except Astral Academy without killing an enemy directly.

guide.context: The level must be completed without directly killing an enemy; letting spawned enemies fall or be crushed is not a direct kill.

steps.text: Replay @loc{Tower of Sarek}, where the only enemies are a few skeletons that spawn near the top.
Climb the tower, using the Thief's grapple and the Wizard's planks to bypass the enemies without attacking them.
Reach the Trine at the top without directly killing any enemy.

achievements.description: Complete at least 5 jumps (or 3 in Enchanted Edition) in a row on different skeletons without touching the ground
achievements.summary: Jump on three different skeletons in a row without touching the ground.

guide.context: Each jump must land on a different skeleton, and touching the ground between jumps resets the chain. The Enchanted Edition requires three.

steps.text: In @loc{Academy Hallways}, reach the area with the two closed doors where several skeletons gather.
Jump from one skeleton's head to another without touching the ground until you have landed on three different skeletons.

achievements.description: Earn all Achievements in Trine
achievements.summary: Earn every other achievement in Trine Enchanted Edition.

guide.context: This meta-achievement unlocks only after the other 32 achievements are earned.

steps.text: Earn the other 32 achievements; @loc{Way Out of the Trine} appears once the last one is complete.
If it does not appear right away, restart the game to trigger it.

achievements.description: Stay underwater for more than 20 seconds without taking damage
achievements.summary: Remain submerged for over 20 seconds without taking any damage.

guide.context: Each hero has a separate breath meter, so switching to a fresh hero extends the time underwater.

steps.text: In @loc{Crystal Caverns}, dive into the water.
Stay submerged and switch to another hero whenever the current hero's breath runs low, repeating until more than 20 seconds have passed.

achievements.description: Find the Academic, Bony and Crystalline holiday secret gifts.
achievements.summary: Recover the Academic, Bony, and Crystalline gifts hidden as holiday secrets.

guide.context: The three gifts sit in @loc{Academy Hallways}, @loc{Dragon Graveyard}, and @loc{Crystal Caverns}. The Dragon Graveyard gift is near the beginning of that level; collect each gift where it appears to complete the set.

collectibles.name: Academic gift
collectibles.location: @loc{Academy Hallways}
collectibles.method: Sweep the level's side paths and off-route ledges for the wrapped @item{gift} and collect it.

collectibles.name: Bony gift
collectibles.location: @loc{Dragon Graveyard}, near the beginning of the level
collectibles.method: Check the early stretch of the level for the wrapped @item{gift} and collect it.

collectibles.name: Crystalline gift
collectibles.location: @loc{Crystal Caverns}
collectibles.method: Sweep the level's side paths and off-route ledges for the wrapped @item{gift} and collect it.

achievements.description: Launch the Enchanted Edition of the game
achievements.summary: Start up Trine Enchanted Edition.

steps.text: Start Trine Enchanted Edition; the achievement unlocks automatically on launch.
